summary: Iter 235 - Demo-Daten-Seed + Belegungs-Uebersicht. All features verified. Backend: 159 passed/5 skipped (pytest). Frontend: Demo-Daten button, OccupancyOverview Gantt-chart, RBAC capabilities all working.
seed_data_creation: Demo-Seed creates: 12 rooms (incl. splittable + catering + approval-required), 12 desks (with floorplan positions), 10 vehicles (Benzin/Diesel/Elektro/Hybrid with fuel cards), 15 catering items, 10 cost centers, 5 accounts, ~97 bookings over 14 days. Idempotent - second call overwrites Demo_ prefixed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 235 fully tested. Demo-Seed endpoint POST /api/resources-seed-demo creates comprehensive test data. Frontend OccupancyOverview component shows timeline with type/days filters, navigation buttons, colored booking bars (green=confirmed, amber=pending, rose=blackout). Splittable rooms show parent + sub-areas as indented rows with arrow prefix.
